WITH acct_trans AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    c.town_city,
    COUNT(ft.transaction_id) as trans_count
  FROM Accounts a
  JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
  WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL AND c.town_city != ''
  GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city
),
town_trans AS (
  SELECT 
    town_city,
    SUM(trans_count) as town_total
  FROM acct_trans
  GROUP BY town_city
),
all_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(trans_count) as avg_trans FROM acct_trans
)
SELECT 
  at.account_id,
  at.town_city,
  at.trans_count as num_transactions,
  at.trans_count * 1.0 / tt.town_total as town_share,
  at.trans_count * 1.0 / aa.avg_trans as ratio_to_avg
FROM acct_trans at
CROSS JOIN all_avg aa
JOIN town_trans tt ON at.town_city = tt.town_city
ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC, at.account_id
LIMIT 10
